description.zh:
批量操作类型。取值：

- **DOMAIN_ADD**：批量添加域名
- **DOMAIN_DEL**：批量删除域名
- **RR_ADD**：批量添加解析
- **RR_DEL**：批量删除解析
> 为空时不做筛选
description.en:
The type of the batch operation. Valid values:

- **DOMAIN\_ADD**: Add domain names in batches.

- **DOMAIN\_DEL**: Delete domain names in batches.

- **RR\_ADD**: Add DNS records in batches.

- **RR\_DEL**: Delete DNS records in batches.

> If you leave this parameter empty, the results are not filtered by operation type.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the request and response. The default value is **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English
The current page number. The default value is **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页设置的大小。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh: 获取指定状态结果详情，不传入则获取所有。
description.en: The status of the task. If you do not specify this parameter, the details of tasks in all states are returned.

title.zh: 查询批量处理结果的详细信息

descriptions.zh: **前提条件：请在批量任务执行完成后，再调用此接口。**
descriptions.en: **Prerequisite: You can call this operation after the batch task is complete.**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-batch-result-detail --lang en --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --task-id 80000000 --batch-type DOMAIN_ADD --status SUCCESS --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeBatchResultDetail --region cn-hangzhou --Status SUCCESS --TaskId 80000000 --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --Lang en --BatchType DOMAIN_ADD
